saw_lines: Perfume buyers test on skin, compare with the last bottle, and rebuy once a scent lasts all day.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where new buyers look for proof and free shipping.
Your site shows 1,048 reviews, yet 0 of 18 ads carry a review count. Print 1,048 on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 13 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 356 and 1,048 reviews, yet 0 of 18 ads carry a review count, so new buyers have no proof to act on. Print 1,048 on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote about the scent.
8 of 14 copy ads open on one line, so most of your range never gets a first look. Test two or three new angles from your own line, like Flor de Madera or the shower gels, each against that opener.

Your site offers free shipping on orders $60+, yet 0 of 18 ads mention shipping or delivery, so new buyers cannot see the deal. Put free shipping on orders $60+ in the first line of your next ads, before the scent story.
One exact copy runs in 8 of 14 ads, so the same words reach the same feed over and over. Keep the body copy, but change the opening line and creative in each of those 8 ads for a fresh first frame.

ads_1: New openers from shower gels and Flor de Madera, tested against Mexico City story
